_nota: Example roles. Fields: slug, nome, capo (slug of the lead, empty = a lead), mandato and metrica (one line each), modello and perche (why that model), vuotoOgniMinuti (0 = wakes up only on messages), autonomia (rodaggio = reads and proposes, operativo = acts inside its mandate), mandatoFile (the full mandate, a markdown file next to this one), colore (leads only, #rrggbb).

ruoli.mandato: Keeps the backlog of the repo short and ordered, and hands work to the researcher and the reviewer.
ruoli.metrica: open items older than two weeks, to be kept at zero
ruoli.perche: decides what the others do, so it is the one whose judgement nobody re-checks

ruoli.mandato: Answers questions about the code and the docs, with the file and the line, and writes what it learns in its notes.
ruoli.metrica: questions from the lead left unanswered
ruoli.perche: reads and summarises, which is the default job of the mid-size model

ruoli.mandato: Reads a change before it is committed and says what could break, with the test that would show it.
ruoli.metrica: changes reviewed within the day they are asked for
ruoli.perche: checks a change against a checklist; the lead takes the decision
